The '''All Terrain Force Reconnaissance Walker (AT-FRC)''' was a two-person bipedal [[Walker/Legends|walker]] used for reconnaissance, first by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and later on by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was derived from the smaller, one-position [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]] (AT-RT).<ref name="LbE" />

The AT-FRC featured a narrow, lightly-[[Armor/Legends|armored]] body between two reverse-articulated legs that gave the walker a smaller silhouette, enabling it to effectively utilize cover. The driver would sit in the higher of the two seats, with the lower being occupied by the reconnaissance systems operator in a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] bubble canopy providing good visibility with few blind spots.<ref name="LbE" />

The walker was equipped with the [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] [[LongView-341.A]] as well as a high-powered encrypted comms system which allowed the easy gathering and transmission of intel. The AT-FRC also possessed stealth systems, such as a [[Sound-Dampening Camouflage System]] to muffle engine noise and allowing camouflage with surroundings, as well as an EMP dampening system which hid energy emissions. Weapon-wise, the walker was outfitted with a double-barrel [[autoblaster]] and a rapid-fire [[Concussion grenade launcher/Legends|concussion grenade launcher]].<ref name="LbE" />
